section.title: Writing Expression from Patterns
section.para: Find the number of dots in Step 5, and write an expression to find \(n\) number of dots.
Step 1 - Make a table to help you find the pattern.

Step 2 - Notice that the start has 2 rows and 2 columns, or 4 dots.
Each step adds a row of 2 dots, plus 1 more dot.
So, each step adds 3 dots.
Step 3 - Continuing this linear pattern, Step 5 would have 19 dots.

Step 4 - An expression could be \(3n+4\).
This is a linear expression.
section.title: Try It: Writing Expression from Patterns

problem.para: Find the number of dots in Step 5, and write an expression to find \(n\) number of dots.
Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.

solution.para: Here is how to write an expression from a pattern:
Each step has that number of dots squared, then doubled, and then one is added.
The expression would be \(2n^2+1\), where \(n\) is the step number.
